Application Data.NAME: Crafty Creations, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Crafty Creations, Inc. is a retail store specializing in a wide range of craft and hobby supplies, including art materials, model kits, paints, adhesives, and tools. We offer instructional workshops and classes on various crafting techniques, ensuring a safe environment with well-maintained premises and effective inventory control systems. Our team is committed to providing excellent customer service and adhering to all local fire and safety regulations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2021, a small fire occurred in the storage area of the store due to an electrical short circuit, resulting in damages amounting to $1,200. The incident was promptly reported, and the damages were fully covered by the property insurance. The store has since taken corrective measures by upgrading the electrical system and conducting regular safety inspections to prevent future occurrences. The claim status is closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B-rated, TL-15 certified safe with UL label, securely installed for protecting cash and inventory.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24/7 alarm monitoring system in place, equipped with surveillance cameras and security personnel during business hours.
